cases.name: Makayla Fay Meave-Byers
cases.about: Mikayla was a teacher's aide at Lexington High School. (Family friend Annie) Gonzales says Makayla was a wonderful mother to her six kids. "She was always the person to walk up to anybody with open arms and give them a hug, even if she didn’t know you," Gonzales said.
cases.narrative: On 9/20/2023, her cousin found her body, rolled in carpet, in a drainage ditch in Pottawatomie County, OK. She had been shot twice in the head. Investigators say he shot her, rolled her in carpet that he borrowed from his neighbor and dumped her in a ditch near their property.
